mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_authorization_invalidation_outbox (id, event_id, change_kind, payload, status, retry_count, max_retry, next_retry_at, source_module, source_biz_id, created_at, updated_at, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{eventId}, #{changeKind}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{maxRetry}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{sourceModule}, #{sourceBizId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{version})
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, change_kind, payload, status, retry_count, max_retry, next_retry_at, last_error, locked_by, locked_at, processed_at, source_module, source_biz_id, created_at, updated_at, version FROM sys_authorization_invalidation_outbox WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_authorization_invalidation_outbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', locked_by = #{lockedBy}, locked_at = #{lockedAt}, updated_at = #{lockedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
UPDATE sys_authorization_invalidation_outbox SET status = 'SUCCESS', processed_at = #{processedAt}, updated_at = #{processedAt}, last_error = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE sys_authorization_invalidation_outbox SET status = #{status}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, last_error = #{lastError}, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_authorization_invalidation_outbox SET last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE sys_authorization_invalidation_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = 0, next_retry_at = NULL, last_error = NULL, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('DEAD', 'FAILED', 'PROCESSING')
